title: Secret Crush Signal Arcade
oneLiner: A playful flirting prototype where two people answer tiny vibe prompts, trade bold signals, and unlock a shared chemistry board without the pressure of a full dating app profile.
targetUser: Singles and couples who want a lighter, more game-like way to test attraction and escalate playful conversation.
keyUX: Send a low-risk signal, watch mutual chemistry meters react in real time, and unlock more intimate prompt cards only when both sides keep leaning in.
stitchPrompt: Design a bold desktop flirting prototype called Secret Crush Signal Arcade for people who want a lighter, more game-like way to test attraction than a standard dating profile grid. It should let two users trade tiny signals, answer escalating vibe prompts, and unlock a shared chemistry board only when interest is mutual. Include a chemistry meter stage, a signal card carousel, a mutual unlock ladder, a private dare and prompt drawer, mood soundtrack controls, and a shareable neon recap card. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with electric gradients, glossy dark surfaces, flirtatious neon accents, and one clear escalating interaction path so the product feels mischievous, stylish, and immediately screenshot-worthy.
